execute.description: copy each row of "_prisma"."marker" into "_prisma"."signatures", with its hashes, its invariants and when it was written
copy the policies recorded on the application's row of "_prisma"."marker", when it records them, into "_prisma"."config"
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "_prisma"."config" ("policies")
SELECT "meta" -> 'policies' FROM "_prisma"."marker"
WHERE "space" = 'app' AND "meta" -> 'policies' IS NOT NULL

postcheck.description: Table "_prisma"."marker" must no longer exist once its rows are moved into "_prisma"."signatures" and "_prisma"."config".
